The blue disc grows to 32.5 mm radius, its white rim is widened to 8 mm, and the star centres are spaced on a 17 mm radius circle. The fly white separator is widened to 8 mm, beside a 10 mm blue bar. These explicit proportion changes preserve all separate stars, the rim and fly separator.
